variables.name: STUDYID
variables.label: Study Identifier
variables.description: Unique identifier for a study.

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.label: Domain Abbreviation
variables.description: Two-character abbreviation for the domain.

variables.name: USUBJID
variables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
variables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product.

variables.name: ECSEQ
variables.label: Sequence Number
variables.description: Sequence number given to ensure uniqueness of subject records within a domain. May be any valid number.

variables.name: ECGRPID
variables.label: Group ID
variables.description: Used to tie together a block of related records in a single domain for a subject.

variables.name: ECREFID
variables.label: Reference ID
variables.description: Internal or external identifier (e.g., kit number, bottle label, vial identifier).

variables.name: ECSPID
variables.label: Sponsor-Defined Identifier
variables.description: Sponsor-defined reference number. May be preprinted on the CRF as an explicit line identifier or defined in the sponsor's operational database. Example: Line number on a CRF page.

variables.name: ECLNKID
variables.label: Link ID
variables.description: Identifier used to link related records across domains.

variables.name: ECLNKGRP
variables.label: Link Group ID
variables.description: Identifier used to link related, grouped records across domains.

variables.name: ECTRT
variables.label: Name of Treatment
variables.description: Name of the intervention treatment known to the subject and/or administrator.

variables.name: ECMOOD
variables.label: Mood
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C125923
variables.description: Mode or condition of the record specifying whether the intervention (activity) is intended to happen or has happened. Values align with BRIDG pillars (e.g., scheduled context, performed context) and HL7 activity moods (e.g., intent, event). Examples: "SCHEDULED", "PERFORMED".

variables.name: ECCAT
variables.label: Category of Treatment
variables.description: Used to define a category of related ECTRT values.

variables.name: ECSCAT
variables.label: Subcategory of Treatment
variables.description: A further categorization of ECCAT values.

variables.name: ECPRESP
variables.label: Pre-Specified
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: Used when a specific intervention is prespecified. Values should be "Y" or null.

variables.name: ECOCCUR
variables.label: Occurrence
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: Used to indicate whether a treatment occurred when information about the occurrence is solicited. ECOCCUR = "N" when a treatment was not taken, not given, or missed.

variables.name: ECREASOC
variables.label: Reason for Occur Value
variables.description: The reason for the value in --OCCUR. If --OCCUR = "N", this is the reason the exposure did not occur.

variables.name: ECDOSE
variables.label: Dose
variables.description: Amount of ECTRT when numeric. Not populated when ECDOSTXT is populated.

variables.name: ECDOSTXT
variables.label: Dose Description
variables.description: Amount of ECTRT when non-numeric. Dosing amounts or a range of dosing information collected in text form. Example: "200-400". Not populated when ECDOSE is populated.

variables.name: ECDOSU
variables.label: Dose Units
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C71620
variables.description: Units for ECDOSE, ECDOSTOT, or ECDOSTXT.

variables.name: ECDOSFRM
variables.label: Dose Form
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66726
variables.description: Dose form for ECTRT. Examples: "TABLET", "LOTION".

variables.name: ECDOSFRQ
variables.label: Dosing Frequency per Interval
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C71113
variables.description: Usually expressed as the number of repeated administrations of ECDOSE within a specific time period. Examples: "Q2H", "QD", "BID".

variables.name: ECDOSTOT
variables.label: Total Daily Dose
variables.description: Total daily dose of ECTRT using the units in ECDOSU. Used when dosing is collected as total daily dose.

variables.name: ECDOSRGM
variables.label: Intended Dose Regimen
variables.description: Text description of the intended schedule or regimen for the Intervention. Example: "TWO WEEKS ON", "TWO WEEKS OFF".

variables.name: ECROUTE
variables.label: Route of Administration
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66729
variables.description: Route of administration for the intervention. Examples: "ORAL", "INTRAVENOUS".

variables.name: ECLOT
variables.label: Lot Number
variables.description: Lot number of the ECTRT product.

variables.name: ECLOC
variables.label: Location of Dose Administration
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C74456
variables.description: Specifies location of administration. Example: "ARM", "LIP".

variables.name: ECLAT
variables.label: Laterality
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C99073
variables.description: Qualifier for anatomical location further detailing laterality of the intervention administration. Examples: "LEFT", "RIGHT".

variables.name: ECDIR
variables.label: Directionality
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C99074
variables.description: Qualifier for anatomical location further detailing directionality. Examples: "ANTERIOR", "LOWER", "PROXIMAL", "UPPER".

variables.name: ECPORTOT
variables.label: Portion or Totality
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C99075
variables.description: Qualifier for anatomical location further detailing distribution (i.e., arrangement of, apportioning of). Examples: "ENTIRE", "SINGLE", "SEGMENT".

variables.name: ECFAST
variables.label: Fasting Status
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: Indicator used to identify fasting status. Examples: "Y", "N".

variables.name: ECPSTRG
variables.label: Pharmaceutical Strength
variables.description: Amount of an active ingredient expressed quantitatively per dosage unit, per unit of volume, or per unit of weight, according to the pharmaceutical dose form.

variables.name: ECPSTRGU
variables.label: Pharmaceutical Strength Units
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C71620
variables.description: Unit for ECPSTRG. Examples: "mg/TABLET", "mg/mL".

variables.name: ECADJ
variables.label: Reason for Dose Adjustment
variables.description: Describes reason or explanation of why a dose is adjusted.

variables.name: TAETORD
variables.label: Planned Order of Element within Arm
variables.description: Number that gives the planned order of the element within the arm.

variables.name: EPOCH
variables.label: Epoch
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C99079
variables.description: Trial epoch of the exposure as collected record. Examples: "RUN-IN", "TREATMENT".

variables.name: ECSTDTC
variables.label: Start Date/Time of Treatment
variables.description: The date/time when administration of the treatment indicated by ECTRT and ECDOSE began.

variables.name: ECENDTC
variables.label: End Date/Time of Treatment
variables.description: The date/time when administration of the treatment indicated by ECTRT and ECDOSE ended. For administrations considered given at a point in time (e.g., oral tablet, pre-filled syringe injection), where only an administration date/time is collected, ECSTDTC should be copied to ECENDTC as the standard representation.

variables.name: ECSTDY
variables.label: Study Day of Start of Treatment
variables.description: Study day of ECSTDTC relative to the sponsor-defined DM.RFSTDTC.

variables.name: ECENDY
variables.label: Study Day of End of Treatment
variables.description: Study day of ECENDTC relative to the sponsor-defined DM.RFSTDTC.

variables.name: ECDUR
variables.label: Duration of Treatment
variables.description: Collected duration of administration. Used only if collected on the CRF and not derived from start and end date/times.

variables.name: ECTPT
variables.label: Planned Time Point Name
variables.description: Text description of time when administration should occur. This may be represented as an elapsed time relative to a fixed reference point, such as time of last dose. See ECTPTNUM and ECTPTREF.

variables.name: ECTPTNUM
variables.label: Planned Time Point Number
variables.description: Numerical version of ECTPT to aid in sorting.

variables.name: ECELTM
variables.label: Planned Elapsed Time from Time Point Ref
variables.description: Planned elapsed time relative to the planned fixed reference (ECTPTREF). This variable is useful where there are repetitive measures. Not a clock time.

variables.name: ECTPTREF
variables.label: Time Point Reference
variables.description: Name of the fixed reference point referred to by ECELTM, ECTPTNUM, and ECTPT. Examples: "PREVIOUS DOSE", "PREVIOUS MEAL".

variables.name: ECRFTDTC
variables.label: Date/Time of Reference Time Point
variables.description: Date/time for a fixed reference time point defined by ECTPTREF.
